digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and Jira DC integration harness
propositions: On-demand CI job must map Jira DC image capabilities and vocabularies via REST endpoints, producing a committed structured artifact with raw request/response evidence rather than discovering capabilities at test time
The job must validate four hardcoded vocabulary mappings (priorities, issue types, statuses, link relations) against the live instance and report presence/absence/mismatch verdicts
The map's provenance—the image digest—must be derived from the Dockerfile's FROM line and committed as asserted data, preventing staleness after image re-pins

All five text field length limits (summary, label, description, comment, and configurable instance property jira.text.field.character.limit) must be measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 and read-back verified to detect silent truncation

The workflow must be workflow_dispatch-only with assertion tests preventing push/PR/schedule triggers, and must run with read-only credentials (REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1) to guarantee no mutation of the instance
Two specific falsifiers from tickets 37e7 and 1a9f (parent field editmeta operations and sub-task parent PUT behavior) must be executed with raw response capture to test two contradictory behaviors
